title: Cannot add an array of file paths to Project settings
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in v4.4.stable.mono.official [4c311cbee]
- Reproducible in v4.3.stable.official [77dcf97d8]

### System information

Godot v4.4.stable.mono - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6094) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-13700K (24 threads)

### Issue description

When developing an editor plugin, I want to add a list of "quick open" scenes to the project settings, for debugging purposes.

However, the PropertyInfo doesn't seem to handle arrays and file path hints at the same time. I can either have a single string that correctly behaves as a file path, or an array of strings that don't:

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/9d3c828c-647a-4a45-9a1c-5e571883b1d7)

This is the code I'm using to initialize the properties:

```gdscript
@tool
extends EditorPlugin

const default_path := "godot_lib/quick_load/default_scene_path"
const path_list := "godot_lib/quick_load/scene_paths"

func _enter_tree() -> void:
	register_quick_load_scenes()

static func register_quick_load_scenes():
	# Works for a single string
	if not ProjectSettings.has_setting(default_path):
		ProjectSettings.set_setting(default_path, "")

	ProjectSettings.set_initial_value(default_path, "")

	ProjectSettings.add_property_info({
		"name": default_path,
		"type": TYPE_STRING,
		"hint": PROPERTY_HINT_FILE,
		"hint_string": "*.tscn,*.scn"
	})

	# Doesn't work for an array of strings
	if not ProjectSettings.has_setting(path_list):
		ProjectSettings.set_setting(path_list, PackedStringArray([]))

	ProjectSettings.set_initial_value(path_list, PackedStringArray([]))

	ProjectSettings.add_property_info({
		"name": path_list,
		"type": TYPE_PACKED_STRING_ARRAY,
		"hint": PROPERTY_HINT_FILE,
		"hint_string": "*.tscn,*.scn"
	})

```
